interventions.timing: first query after executing the native alarm query; no intervention if already terminated
interventions.short_chunk: uniform integer 1..9, first branch query only; discard tail and replan; then chunk=10
interventions.edge_noise: maximum mean pairwise Hellinger distance; HB back four layers, first three flow steps, action tokens 1..10
interventions.noise_pool: four independent N(0,1) arrays [10,24] per state/replicate; random control uses candidate 0
interventions.swap1: existing swap1_near on first branch query only, paired with candidate 0
interventions.subsequent_noise: same per-query-index stream across arms; physical times differ after shortening
interventions.environment: same per-query-index seed across arms; actual executed steps bounded by original horizon
interventions.compute: all four candidate forwards counted once as shared preparation; selected first forward reused
